00205 inline void Ran088::setSeed(unsigned long seed) throw()
00206 {
00207   int* seedPtr = 0;
00208   
00209   if(seed == 0)
00210   {
00211     // use the addess of an allocated pointer as the seed
00212     seedPtr = new int;
00213     seed = (unsigned long)seedPtr;
00214     seed *= 39458953U;
00215     seed += 18479161U;
00216   }
00217   
00218   // initialize seeds using the given seed value taking care of
00219   // the requirements. The constants below are arbitrary otherwise
00220   s1 = 1243598713U ^ seed; if (s1 <  2) s1 = 1243598713U;
00221   s2 = 3093459404U ^ seed; if (s2 <  8) s2 = 3093459404U;
00222   s3 = 1821928721U ^ seed; if (s3 < 16) s3 = 1821928721U; 
00223   
00224   delete seedPtr; 
00225 }

00241 inline unsigned long Ran088::next() throw()
00242 {
00243   // generate a random 32 bit number
00244   s1 = ((s1 &  -2) << 12) ^ (((s1 << 13) ^  s1) >> 19);
00245   s2 = ((s2 &  -8) <<  4) ^ (((s2 <<  2) ^  s2) >> 25);
00246   s3 = ((s3 & -16) << 17) ^ (((s3 <<  3) ^  s3) >> 11);
00247   return s1 ^ s2 ^ s3;
00248 }

00250 inline double Ran088::nextDouble() throw()
00251 {
00252   // return a double from 0.0 to 0.999...
00253 #if BYTE_ORDER == BIG_ENDIAN
00254   union { struct { unsigned long hi, lo; } i; double f; } du;
00255 #else
00256   union { struct { unsigned long lo, hi; } i; double f; } du;
00257 #endif
00258   du.i.hi = 0x41300000; 
00259   du.i.lo = next();
00260   return du.f - 1048576.;
00261 }

00273 inline float Ran088::nextFloat() throw()
00274 {
00275   // return a float from 0.0 to 0.999...
00276   union { unsigned long i; float f; } u;    // union for floating point conversion of result
00277   u.i = 0x3F800000 | (next() >> 9);
00278   return u.f - 1.f;
00279 }

00305 inline float Ran088::coin() throw()
00306 {
00307   // only return one of the two values -1.0 or +1.0
00308   union { unsigned long i; float f; } u;    // union for floating point conversion of result
00309   u.i = 0x3F800000 | (0x80000000 & next());
00310   return u.f;

00403 inline double Ran088::nextGaussianApprox(double scale) throw()
00404 {
